observation.visible_scene: A right hand grips a clear plastic water bottle in a basement/utility room. The bottle stands on a white horizontal ledge. Background: a grey water-heater tank on the left with a small figurine charm hanging on a chain, shelves holding cleaning products (a blue detergent bottle), ceiling pipes, and a yellow machine on the right. The hand holds the bottle around its upper/middle section, thumb pressing the label side.
visible_changes: At the start the bottle rests on the ledge (frames 1-7).
The hand lifts the bottle upward so its base clears the ledge (frames ~8-14); an oval shadow of the bottle is visible on the ledge during this lifted interval.
The hand lowers the bottle back onto the ledge (frame 15 onward), where it remains resting for the rest of the clip.
While resting, the grip shifts slightly and the bottle/hand make small positional adjustments but no large motion.
The upper portion of the bottle appears increasingly frosted/opaque over the clip (more pronounced in the later frames).
The hanging figurine and the background objects stay in essentially fixed positions throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: What prompted the lift-and-replace action, and whether the bottle is moved again after the clip ends.
The full vertical extent of the bottle (cap/top is cropped out in several frames).
uncertain_details: Whether the whitening of the bottle top is condensation/frost forming or a change in lighting/exposure.
Any very slight sway of the hanging charm is not clearly distinguishable from static positioning.
Minor frame-to-frame shifts of the background could be small camera movement or hand-induced framing, not confidently separable.
